base.note: Focused preexam UX/telemetry patch over the audited v1.6.1 baseline.

changes.EXAM_3DIGIT_162: Question numbering uses fixed three-digit formatting; combined historical exams preserve A/B provenance.
changes.ANSWER_SHEET_FIXED_SLOTS_162: Answer-sheet number cells reserve independent fixed slots for review flag, number, and question doubt so ? does not resize rows.
changes.STUDY_DECISION_CONTROLS_162: Ordinary practice adds physically separate candidate (◉) and discard (×) controls next to every option without changing final-answer click behavior.
changes.DECISION_TELEMETRY_162: Candidate/crossed states persist in practice_sessions.state.scratch with the established __paper_candidate__/__paper_crossed__ synthetic keys for later export.
changes.MEMORY_ISOLATION_162: Candidate/crossed telemetry is intentionally excluded from uncertain_options/was_uncertain/memory_rating/speed_bucket/FSRS.
changes.IMMEDIATE_FEEDBACK_FREEZE_162: Decision marks become read-only once an immediate-feedback answer is submitted, preventing post-feedback contamination.
changes.V161_PRESERVED: Canonical A16 filtering, observed historical exposure, MEDIA134 queues and learner-facing letter hygiene remain intact.
changes.PROTECTED_SESSION_FILES: session-core.js and session-storage.js remain byte-identical to v1.6.1/v1.6.0 protected baseline.

supabase_migration.note: No migration. Telemetry is stored in existing practice_sessions.state JSONB scratch.

dataset_revision_note: Supabase postcheck confirmed the PREEXAM AUD195 patch: 195 questions updated, 2 flags resolved, 195 history rows, 44 open flags remaining.

qa.manual_smoke: Verify visible v1.6.2; simulator 001/015 and fixed ? slot; ordinary practice ◉/× do not select answers; candidate/crossed persist after navigation/reopen.
